findings.title: Fail closed when the cold listener inventory cannot be enumerated
findings.body: The cold-mode query explicitly suppresses nonterminating Get-NetTCPConnection errors using -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue, then saves its empty output as listeners=[]. Both Installer cold() and Cold cold() interpret this as positive evidence that original ports8787/8790 are free, including before release issuance and executable replacement. A permission/provider/enumeration failure can therefore satisfy the cold precondition without a successful TCP inventory. Obtain a complete Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop inventory and filter its successful output to the two ports, as the current service-identity.ps1 already does. Preserve the rest of the helper and immutable V1 package. Owner-mode nonempty-listener consumers are separately fail closed; this finding concerns the cold empty-set authority.
